# Individual pooled Poisson bootstrap control

`input.csv` is the existing 21-commune synthetic pooled-Poisson fixture with
commune21's singleton count changed from one to zero. It has 241 source rows,
240 complete cases, unequal cluster sizes and an all-zero commune. It is not
publisher data. `draw_indices.csv` contains 500 draws of 21 zero-based
first-seen cluster indices from an independent Python xoshiro256++/SplitMix64
oracle at seed10001. Every index was checked against the native stream.

`fits.csv` and `summary.csv` were generated by base R4.6.2 `glm.fit` QR on
actual expanded group copies, with type7 percentiles and B−1 covariance.
`predictions.csv` and `groups.csv` are the independent R original-fit/source
results. All input rows, 10,500 ordered indices, 500 refits, 121 covariance
cells, coefficient summaries and 240 predictions are audited by the focused
Rust tests and development checker. Reproduce from a fresh directory with the
commands in `examples/mma24p2poiscluster/individual_pooled_bootstrap.md`, using
`--synthetic` for the Python checker and `--csv` for the R reference. R/Python
are optional development tools, not production dependencies.
